_note: Changes That Never Clash: bare previs of the far terraces, the stepped hillside at the island's southern tip, with a pebble table on each of five terraces (set 'terraces'; art/sets/terraces.json gives each table's place). No cast: the image pass adds the people; each note is the picture's brief.

cover.note: The far terraces at the southern tip in morning light: stepped stone terraces above the sea, a table on each terrace with columns of white and black pebbles in shallow grooves, and a scribe at each table adding a pebble to the column at his own end.

p01-terraces.note: The stepped hillside from the sea: a flight of terraces, a stone table on each, and scribes at them, far from every assembly.

p02-table.note: A stone table on a terrace, its top grooved in columns, a pile of pebbles in each column; the scribe sets one more white pebble in the column at his own end and no other.

p03-pier.note: The far shore from above: terraces stepping down to a small landing where a courier ship has put in with tables written on tablets.

p04-tip.note: The southern tip at dusk-light, terraces lit from the side, the sea beyond; a courier carries a wax tablet of one table up the steps to the next terrace.
